status: exploratory extension, specified after the conditional-vertex-null pilot and before the filtration pilot
question: Are extra barriers rare across thresholds or just at the primary cutoff?

method: exact union-find superlevel merge tree, one activation batch per distinct retention value; finite positive bars inside full compatibility components
